items.title: Vision
items.text: To become a globally trusted technology company that creates sustainable value through technology and improves the future of people and businesses.

items.title: Mission
items.text: To co-create value with our customers and partners by designing, developing, delivering and continually improving reliable, secure and sustainable digital products and services.

items.title: Trust & Integrity
items.text: We act with honesty, integrity and transparency in everything we do. We honour our commitments.

items.title: Value Creation
items.text: We aim to create meaningful value for our customers, partners and stakeholders in everything we do.

items.title: Customer Focus
items.text: We listen to our customers, understand their needs and develop solutions that support their success.

items.title: Quality & Reliability
items.text: We make quality part of our culture and aim to deliver reliable and secure products and services.

items.title: Collaboration & Transparency
items.text: We share knowledge, work together and support shared success through open communication.

items.title: Innovation
items.text: We explore new ideas and technologies, embrace change and develop innovative solutions to real needs.

items.title: Simplicity
items.text: We turn complex problems into simple, clear, accessible and practical solutions.

items.title: Continual Improvement
items.text: We learn from experience, value feedback and continually improve our products, services and processes.

items.title: Responsibility & Sustainability
items.text: We take responsibility for our decisions, respect people, society and the environment, and use technology ethically and responsibly.

items.title: Focus on Value
items.text: We focus all our activities on creating value for our customers and stakeholders. We evaluate our decisions based on both technical requirements and business outcomes.

items.title: Start Where You Are
items.text: Before starting new initiatives, we assess our existing processes, resources, technologies and experience. We retain and improve existing solutions that provide value.

items.title: Progress Iteratively with Feedback
items.text: We divide our work into small, manageable and measurable stages. We use feedback at each stage to guide our progress and improvement.

items.title: Collaborate and Promote Visibility
items.text: We communicate openly with our customers, partners and stakeholders. We promote knowledge sharing, collaboration and visibility across our processes.

items.title: Think and Work Holistically
items.text: We consider our products, services and business processes as interconnected parts of a complete system rather than isolated activities.

items.title: Keep It Simple and Practical
items.text: We avoid unnecessary complexity, bureaucracy and activities that do not create value. We design solutions that are clear, practical and sustainable.

items.title: Optimize and Automate
items.text: We analyse and optimise our processes before automating them. We use appropriate technologies to improve efficiency, reduce the risk of errors and make effective use of our resources.

quality-policy.title: Quality & Service Management Policy
intro:
At ERSSOFT Limited, we are committed to creating sustainable value together with our customers and stakeholders, delivering reliable, secure and innovative products and services, and continually improving customer satisfaction.
In line with our vision, mission, core values and ITIL guiding principles, we are committed to:

items.title: Customer Satisfaction
items.text: Understanding and meeting our customers' needs, expectations and business objectives.

items.title: Value Co-creation
items.text: Creating sustainable value through collaboration with our customers, partners and other stakeholders.

items.title: Product & Service Quality
items.text: Managing our products and services throughout their lifecycles with a focus on quality, reliability, accessibility and usability.

items.title: Service Continuity
items.text: Supporting service availability and continuity, minimising disruptions and restoring services safely as quickly as possible.

items.title: Information Security & Privacy
items.text: Protecting the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information and managing personal data securely and responsibly.

items.title: Risk Management
items.text: Identifying and assessing risks and opportunities and taking appropriate action.

items.title: Change Enablement
items.text: Ensuring that changes are planned, controlled, tested and managed according to their risks.

items.title: Problem Management
items.text: Identifying the root causes of problems, taking appropriate corrective action and preventing recurrence.

items.title: Compliance
items.text: Meeting applicable legal, regulatory and contractual requirements.

items.title: Resource Management
items.text: Using our resources effectively and efficiently, optimising our processes and automating appropriate activities.

items.title: Ethics & Sustainability
items.text: Using technology and artificial intelligence ethically, securely and responsibly, while respecting people, society and the environment.

items.title: Continual Improvement
items.text: Setting measurable objectives, regularly reviewing our performance, developing our capabilities and continually improving our management system.

end:
Our management is committed to implementing this policy, providing the necessary resources, communicating it to relevant stakeholders and reviewing it regularly.
We believe that quality is not only an objective but also an essential part of our corporate culture and the way we work.

governance.title: Corporate Governance
intro: Our governance framework is designed to support responsible decision-making and sustainable value creation.

items.title: Evaluate
items.text: Evaluate stakeholder needs, opportunities, risks, resources and performance.

items.title: Direct
items.text: Direct strategy, policies, objectives and investment.

items.title: Monitor
items.text: Monitor performance, compliance, quality and outcomes.

end: This approach describes a management design, not evidence of implementation or certification.
